name: Racing
para: Racing is the ultimate adrenaline rush, blending speed, skill, and fierce competition. 🏎️

name: Story
para: Stories transport us to different worlds, weaving imagination, emotion, and adventure into unforgettable experiences. 📖

name: Battle Royale
para: Battle Royale is an intense survival genre where players fight to be the last one standing in a shrinking battlefield. 🎯

name: Adventure
para: Adventure is all about exploring unknown worlds, facing challenges, and discovering new stories. 🌍

name: RPG
para: RPGs are games where players live out characters' adventures and decisions 🎮

name: Action
para: Action is all about intense battles, fast-paced scenes, and thrilling heroics that keep you on the edge of your seat. 💥

name: Fighting
para: Fighting is all about intense duels, skillful combat, and epic clashes of strength and strategy. 🥊

name: Sports
para: Sports are a celebration of skill, teamwork, and the thrill of competition that unites people worldwide. ⚽

name: Puzzle
para: Puzzle games challenge the mind with logic, strategy, and creative problem-solving, offering endless fun and satisfaction. 🧩

name: Simulation
para: Simulation immerses players in realistic scenarios, offering a chance to experience and control complex systems or lifelike activities. 🖥️

name: Shooter
para: Shooting focuses on precision, reflexes, and strategy, delivering fast-paced, adrenaline-pumping action. 🎯

name: Platformer
para: Platformers are all about timing, precision, and exploration as players navigate obstacles and levels. 🎮

name: Arcade
para: Arcade games are fast-paced and fun, designed to deliver quick thrills and high scores through simple yet addictive gameplay. 🕹️

name: Massively Multiplayer
para: Massively Multiplayer games connect players globally for shared adventures, battles, and cooperative experiences in vast virtual worlds. 🌐

name: Indie
para: Indie games are creative, independently developed titles that showcase unique ideas, artistic styles, and innovative gameplay beyond mainstream productions. 🎨🎮

name: Card
para: Card games combine strategy, luck, and skill in a fun, competitive format for players of all ages. 🃏

name: Strategy
para: Strategy games focus on planning, tactics, and decision-making to outsmart opponents or solve complex challenges. ♟️

name: Casual
para: Casual games are easy-to-play, relaxing experiences designed for quick entertainment and fun. 🎮

name: Family
para: Family games foster connection, fun, and memorable moments for players of all ages to enjoy together. 🧡

name: Board Games
para: Board games are timeless fun, blending strategy, luck, and social interaction for players of all ages. 🎲

name: Educational
para: Educational games make learning fun by combining entertainment with knowledge and skill-building. 📚
